expected_observable_behavior.zh: 第10–25天同工况下转矩残差持续上升；转速不变。
expected_observable_behavior.en: Days 10–25: torque residual rises steadily under the same regimes; speed unchanged.

ground_truth.zh: 丝杠摩擦参数线性增加 0.6（第10→25天）。

expected_health_response.zh: 10天前 NORMAL；漂移期 WATCH→WARNING；22天后 WARNING/CRITICAL。直线电机保持 NORMAL。
expected_health_response.en: NORMAL before day 10; WATCH→WARNING during the drift; WARNING/CRITICAL after day 22. Linear motor stays NORMAL.

abstention_cases.zh: 无强制弃权；空闲/停机窗口不评估健康状态。
abstention_cases.en: No mandatory abstention; idle/stopped windows are not assessed.

abstention_cases.zh: 无失效数据：失效概率/RUL 必须返回不支持（NO_FAILURE_EVIDENCE）。
abstention_cases.en: No failure data: failure probability/RUL must return unsupported (NO_FAILURE_EVIDENCE).

limitations.zh: 转矩升高只说明负载/摩擦变化，不能单独证明丝杠磨损。
limitations.en: Higher torque indicates a load/friction change; it does not alone prove ball-screw wear.
